scope: One authored Sahil map: measured reference elevation study followed by original geometry, reachable lower return, physical arched doors, stepped circulation and larger game C4 effects.
media: No source-game exported media or navigation is loaded by this beta. Authored ARENA geometry, materials, operators, effects, atlas and shared audio retained.
motion: 20-joint analytic rig; terrain-aware stance IK, acceleration/braking, aim anticipation, authored cubic action keyframes and equipment recovery; not mocap.

map.name: Sahil
map.referenceGuide: Private offline source-collision elevation study: 77,976 grid queries at 1m and 3,940 route samples at 0.1m. Only summary counts and scalar elevation ranges recorded; source vertices, navigation and materials excluded from release.
map.remainingLayoutIssue: Own hand-authored reference-inspired tactical plan; not a 1:1 reconstruction or legal clearance. Independent spatial design/review remains a separate release task.

c4.cover: Three physical body exposure rays; blocked blast damage reduced to 12%; 3D distance and quadratic falloff. Immediate damage approximation.
c4.props: Twelve actual authored crate objects: mass-weighted impulse, solid collisions, settling on current floor, scattered planks, live cover removal and save restore.

ui: Same original club manager and match HUD; compiled CSS unchanged.
storage: Old20–28 active rounds restart once, preserving score, round, player statistics and money. Current29 snapshots including moved/broken map props resume. Root career/cache preserved.
architecture: Polygonal closed foundations and roof parapets, chamfered Long vestibule, four curved-profile hinged double doors and arch frames, thirteen connecting wall sections, lower-return vaulted frames, two octagonal observatory domes and shared visual/physical stair guards.
navigation: Authored cached two-layer metre grid, height-aware collision and sampled path smoothing, separate low CT street and raised Short crossing; no exported navigation.
camera: Separate oblique damped player/auto tracking. Minimum vertical field 22/28 m in landscape, wider in narrow viewports; minimum applied to old camera seeds.
water: West coast outside playfield: animated vertex waves, Fresnel tint, specular highlights, foam and nearshore transparency.
elevation: Shared authored levels, 58 stair treads with rise <=17cm and run >=28cm, CT A and Long ramps, upper Short deck over graded CT street, terrain foundations closed down to surrounding apron.
